title: Fingerprinting and stack identification
status: AUTHORED. Small domain, high leverage: the stack profile it produces is the input to every hypothesis.

atom_notes.A15: fingerprinting is measuring configuration divergence between what is claimed and what is running
atom_notes.A08: banners, versions and build artefacts are information exposure
atom_notes.A06: vhost and path differentials reveal namespaces that answer differently
atom_notes.A05: version to feature mapping is how a fingerprint becomes a testable hypothesis
atom_notes.A03: TLS and client fingerprints identify the stack on both sides of the connection

required_cells.why: a stack profile is the input to every downstream hypothesis
version to known issue mapping is the payoff of fingerprinting
confirming a fingerprint with a second engine before acting on it

entries.name: whatweb
oracle: framework, server, version and plugin list
entries.note: Aggression 1 only. Higher is loud and rarely changes the answer.

entries.name: httpx
entries.role: Status, title, tech detect and TLS at scale
oracle: per host tech fingerprint in json
entries.note: The tech-detect field is what feeds the stack profile that D01 hypotheses depend on.

entries.name: nmap
entries.role: Service and version truth when headers disagree
entries.note: The arbiter. When httpx and the HTML disagree, this decides.

entries.name: nuclei
oracle: template match identifying a product or version

entries.name: ffuf
entries.role: Vhost and virtual directory discovery by response differential
oracle: vhost or path that responds differently

entries.name: wafw00f
entries.role: WAF fingerprint, which decides the evasion class
entries.note: Run before payload selection, never after. The WAF determines which mutation axis matters.

entries.name: rea analyze_web_bundle
entries.role: Vendor fingerprints and framework evidence from the bundle, which headers cannot show
oracle: vendor and framework identification from code
entries.note: The most reliable fingerprint for SPA stacks. Headers lie; the bundle's dependencies do not.

entries.name: Favicon hash via httpx -favicon
entries.role: Shodan style favicon hash to identify a product across hosts you cannot otherwise correlate
preconditions: the favicon is served and stable
entries.note: The technique is well established, the repo originally cited here does not exist. httpx implements favicon hashing with -favicon, which is verified.

entries.name: TLS fingerprint (JA3/JA4)
entries.role: Identify the client stack and detect whether a target fingerprints you back
entries.note: Read this defensively too: if the target uses it, your default client is already identified.

entries.name: Wappalyzer technology rules
entries.role: The rule set most tools copy, useful as a second opinion

entries.name: WSTG Information Gathering (11 tests)
entries.role: The test list this domain implements

tree.q: Do you have an origin, or only a DNS name?
tree.why: A DNS name gives you vhosts and certificates. An origin gives you behaviour. The strongest identification comes from combining them, and most people stop at headers.

branches.action: certificate transparency for names, then vhost probing, then resolve each to a live origin
branches.oracle: additional names or vhosts that answer

branches.action: headers, then bundle dependencies, then a second engine. if the three disagree, the bundle is usually right
branches.oracle: three sources agreeing on a stack

branches.action: fingerprint from dependencies, not headers. headers for a SPA are usually the CDN
branches.oracle: framework and version from bundle evidence

branches.action: fingerprint the WAF first, because it determines which evasion class applies to everything else

mirror.detect: server and framework version in headers or body
mirror.control: strip version headers, generic error pages

mirror.detect: a scanner fingerprinting then immediately probing a known CVE
requests with Host headers that do not match inventory

gaps.gap: No tool gives a confidence weighted stack profile as a single artifact
gaps.build_candidate: merge http, bundle, tls and favicon evidence into one profile with per field confidence and source

gaps.gap: No version to known issue mapper that uses the local corpus instead of a web lookup
gaps.build_candidate: join the fingerprint with CVE and nuclei template metadata already on disk
scheduled re-fingerprint plus a diff report keyed on stack fields
